import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        total += int(data[i])
    # C++ integer division truncates toward zero, so use int(total / n)
    result = int(total / n) if n != 0 else 0  # n will not be 0 in valid input
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
